title: promptfoo
oneLiner: Open-source tool for testing prompts, agents, RAG systems, and AI security behavior.
summary: promptfoo is an MIT-licensed testing and red-teaming tool for prompts, agents, RAG pipelines, and AI application behavior, with declarative configs and CI/CD-friendly workflows.
whyItMatters: Agent teams need repeatable tests before shipping changes. promptfoo gives builders a practical way to compare prompts, models, providers, and safety behavior without relying only on manual review.
bestFor: Teams testing prompts, agents, and RAG systems
Developers adding AI evaluations to CI/CD
Builders doing red-team or vulnerability checks on AI workflows
notFor: Teams that need only production tracing
Users who want a benchmark score without writing test cases
